history.summary: A 1,722 sqft 4BR in Pasir Ris (D18) at $2.25M and $1,307 psf — ~5% below the $1,382 median, in the more digestible sub-$2.5M band, with the future CRL Elias station 380m away. Solid 4.48% appreciation on 123 txns; the CRL proximity is the standout catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: The CP2 Elias station (Cross Island Line, ~2030) at just 380m is the strongest forward catalyst among the 4BR entries — future-MRT-within-500m gives the largest uplift per the rubric. $2.25M keeps it inside the more liquid sub-$2.5M band (vs the $2.98M Ripple Bay), $1,307 psf is ~5% under median, and 4.48% resale-only on a reliable 123-txn series is solid for OCR. Elo 1918, on frontier. The 1,722 sqft 4BR is still a family-only niche, but the CRL catalyst plus reasonable quantum and below-median entry justify a Buy.

CRL uplift is years out (~2030) and partly anticipated
catalysts: Future CRL Elias station 380m — within-500m future MRT, strongest uplift driver

history.summary: 99yr 2016 1BR in Pasir Ris (D18, OCR). Algo flags it cheap (-6.2% age-adj, -4.5% cohort) but a same-size 581sqft 1BR transacted Mar-2025 at $1,308 PSF, so this $1,442 PSF asking is actually ~10% ABOVE verified comparable resale. CRL 2029 is a real catalyst but the entry price already captures fair value, not a bargain.
history.rating_rationale: The decisive fact is a verified same-size comparable: a 581 sqft 1BR sold Mar-2025 at $760,000 = $1,308 PSF, while this unit asks $838,000 = $1,442 PSF (~10% higher). Stratum's 12-month average is ~$1,302-1,367 PSF, so the asking is at the top of the range, not below it. The algo's cheap signals (psf_cohort_txns=6, thin) don't survive web verification. OCR gives the best forward regional prior (+4.0%) and the Cross Island Line interchange at Pasir Ris (2029) is a genuine medium-term catalyst, which keeps this from an Avoid, but at this asking there is no value edge today.
red_flags: Asking $1,442 PSF is ~10% above a verified same-size 581sqft 1BR resale at $1,308 PSF (Mar-2025)
Algo cheapness rests on a thin 6-transaction cohort that web data contradicts
Far-east location with long CBD commute pending CRL completion (2029)
catalysts: Cross Island Line interchange at Pasir Ris MRT (~2029) adding to existing East-West Line
OCR region carries the strongest realized forward appreciation prior (~+4.0%)
